what_went_well: You completed the square correctly in Step 2 and the exact root you wrote in Step 3 is valid.
what_went_wrong: At Step 3 you took only one square-root branch. Solving (x + 2)^2 = 3 requires both x + 2 = sqrt(3) and x + 2 = -sqrt(3), so one valid solution was lost.
how_to_improve: Whenever you remove a square, write the ± sign before rearranging. Here, write x + 2 = ±sqrt(3), then state x = -2 + sqrt(3) and x = -2 - sqrt(3).
references: Notes §3 — square roots and the plus-or-minus sign
